_about: ASSET-005 Barkbound Husk kitbash v2: vanilla parts on the vanilla Draugr. Rigid parts: the vanilla mesh under a child of the named Draugr bone with the given local transform (Unity, bind pose; bones carry a bind scale of 110). Skinned parts: the vanilla Player-rig mesh rebound to the Draugr: bones[i] = draugr_bone of the source bone, and bindposes[i] = inverse(DraugrBoneBindWorld) * retarget_matrix_unity * PlayerBoneBindWorld * original_bindpose[i].
